sampling: Body blocks (prose paragraphs, list items, tables, display equations; headings and images excluded) numbered 1-26 from L16; took blocks 1,4,7,10,13,16,19,22,25, then wrapped to 2,5. Claims drawn from L16, L26, L34, L40, L48, L58, L69, L77-79, L81, L20, L30.

A: Headings are topic names, not claims: L18 '## 연구 배경', L28 '## 제안 방법', L46 '## 구현 방식', L52 '## 실험 결과', L73 '## 의의와 한계' (fixed summary shape; front matter, math delimiters and blank lines around L32/L36 display math are correct).
B: L16 '학습 처리량은 전체 파인튜닝(fine-tuning)보다 약 25% 빨랐습니다' - throughput is not 'fast' -> '학습 속도는 전체 파인튜닝보다 약 25% 빨랐습니다'.
L38 two '그래서' sentences in one paragraph ('그래서 학습을 시작할 때 ...', '그래서 저자들은 ...') -> '... 0이므로 모델은 처음에 사전학습 모델과 똑같이 동작합니다', '... 거의 같아서 저자들은 ...'.
L26 formulaic '결국 추론 지연을 더하지 않으면서 ... 적응법이 필요했습니다' -> '추론 지연 없이 파라미터를 늘린 만큼 성능이 오르는 적응법이 필요했던 이유입니다' or drop '결국'.
Terminology mixing: L24 '$$\text{Adapter}^{\text{L}}$$' vs L71 'Adapter-L'; L42 '편향' vs L80 '바이어스'; L26 'MultiNLI-matched' vs L58 'MNLI-matched'; '(fine-tuning)' glossed twice (L16, L20).
C: Dangling back-reference L60 '저데이터 실험에는 앞서 소개한 MNLI 무작위 부분집합을 썼고' - no earlier paragraph introduces MNLI subsets.
L71 re-introduces Adapter-L ('Adapter-L은 Lin et al.의 어댑터 방식입니다') already defined at L24, and appends a GPT-3 hypothetical to a GPT-2 latency paragraph, so the results section reads stitched.
D: Good: intrinsic dimension defined at first use (L30); alpha/r scaling explained with its reason (L38); a numeric parameter-count example (L40, 1,048,576 vs 8,192).
L40 uses a hypothetical d=k=1,024 instead of the paper's own scale (GPT-3 d_model 12,288, 10,000x fewer trainable parameters), so the reader never sees the real magnitude.
E: No table for the headline GPT-3 175B comparison (FT 73.8/89.5/52.0-28.0-44.5 vs LoRA 73.4-74.0/91.6-91.7/53.4-53.8...); rank results L48 and latency L71 are dense prose numbers that a small table would carry better.
Figures (L22, L56) are described in words, not by paper numbering; the low-data table L62-67 copies all 16 cells verbatim.
F: L30 defines intrinsic dimension as '무작위로 고른 저차원 부분공간에서만 파라미터를 움직여도 전체 성능에 가깝게 도달하는 데 필요한 최소 차원' - the LoRA paper gives no definition; it is roughly Aghajanyan et al.'s (90% of full performance) but unsourced here.
U1: Motivation, method and implementation are covered well, but results omit the main GPT-3 Table 4 numbers (LoRA vs FT on WikiSQL/MNLI/SAMSum), all RoBERTa/DeBERTa/GPT-2 benchmarks, and the 10,000x parameter / 3x memory / 350GB->35MB checkpoint reductions.
U2: TL;DR (L16) is three sentences of plain prose without math; grounded limitations L79-81. Weight merging / no added latency is restated at L16, L44, L71 and L75, and the task-swap example at L44 and L75, which costs concision.
